predictions: Added another 2-1 from postponed week 1 matches, and then posted a pretty decent 17-7 in week 2. That brings me to 32-14 so far, for a correct pick rate just below 70% so far. That's pretty good, but the odd part is "which" matches I'm getting right and wrong so far this season. I'm pretty much owning from C through G divisions (26-8 combined so far), while I'm only 3-3 in each of A and B. I told everyone preseason that B would be a mess this season, but usually A is my most accurate division.

Match of the week: (F Div.) The Dartifacts @ Dart Knights. Only one F team is getting through week 3 without a loss, and it will be the winner of this huge showdown. And the best part is that this top-of-F battle last season's top-of-G battle! New to the F show and taking control right off the bat. Man, this is such a good pairing, and I'm guessing it goes to the last 501. I'm loving The Dartifacts' balance so far, 13-11.

Match #2: (C Div.) Village Idiots @ Wing & A Plaque. Another pair that will decide the only team in the division to reach week 4 undefeated. I've been feeling Wing as the division's favorite, but I'll admit the fact that they needed a 501 Houdini act last week to stay on top has me a bit nervous. I'm still flying with the Wing for now though, but only 14-10.

Matches #3 & #4: (B Div.) Why So Serious? @ Raging Bulls; Double In Stumble Out @ The Outlaws. The last two B teams yet to lose face big challenges tonight, each drawing one of the 1-1 teams tied for 3rd place. If the home teams win these, the predictably hot mess B becomes a hotter mess right off the bat than even I expected. Alas, Serious has looked like a wrecking ball through two weeks, and I have to stick with them here, 15-9. And Stumble Out, who just took a tiebreaker from those Ragers, might have just enough to outlast The Outlaws as well, 13-11.

Match #5: (D Div.) Menace 2 Sobriety @ Irish Ton. The Irish have taken a loss already, but are still easily within reach of the leaders. Menace, however, is looking pretty strong out of the gate, and likely see this as a chance to knock another contender back. Menace, 14-10.

Matches #6 & #7: (G Div.) Heart of Dartness @ Bright side of Flights; We're Sexy & We Throw It @ 21 Dart Salute. The two undefeated G teams who have already had a bye (meaning they are each only 1-0) square off against the two 1-1 teams in the middle of the division. Could be a lot of clarity added to the G division script after this pair of matches. I'm thinking Dartness will be in the title chase all spring, winning 15-9 here. And We Throw It edges out Dart Salute, 13-11.

Match #8: (A Div.) Show Me Your Tips @ Dart Attack. Oh, man, A division is looking like a hot mess of a great free-for all. These teams are 1-2 combined and good enough to take out roughly any opponent. Good stuff, buddy. I'll take the updated Show me, 13-11.

Match #9: (E Div.) Cheap Shots @ Bangin The Wire. Last season, Bangin limped to an 0-2 start before ripping off a 9-3 run to climb all the way into second place. Are they reliving the same script here? Against one of the three undefeated teams in E?! I think so…13-11.

Match #10: (E Div.) Rippin Darts @ Bottoms Up. Here's another of the three undefeated E teams (Bottoms), but this one has to face the top team of the other five at this point. Rippin is 1-1 with a good showing against the Ducks already. But the Bottoms take this, 15-9.

Match #11: (B Div.) Kids Mis-B-having @ Mulligan's Mafia. After this one, only one B team will be left winless. Given that these two combined for a 15-9 record (one in B, one in C) last season, neither of these two likely thought they would be here. I'll go Kids, 14-10.

Match #12: (G Div.) Flight Club @ Game of Throws. Well, every season some team finishes in 'that spot.' And here what looks to be the first battle in really determining who that team will be. Club, 15-9.

Match #13: (C Div.) Darty Little Secrets @ Nine Lives. The Little Secrets are 0-1 (at the time of this writing), but that one loss was a tough fight against Wing. I'm thinking the Secrets move up, 14-10.
And the remaining 11 matches, sorted by division:
A Division: Element 18, Consistent 6; Fringe 16, Darty Minds 8.
C Division: Little Secrets 13, Nine Lives 11; Rif Raf 15, Bandits 9.
D Division: Off Constantly 13, One Dart Wonders 11; Liquor Possee 13, Darty Sanchez 11; Dirty Darts 17, Red-eye Rangers 7.
E Division: Machine 13, Ton 80 Proof 11; Waddle In 15, Corks 9.
